info.title: Shorty API
info.description:
The Shorty developer API. Authenticate with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer shk_…`) or an OAuth 2.1 access token. Errors follow RFC 9457 (application/problem+json).

Guides and reference: [Quickstart](https://aishorty.com/docs/api) · [Operations](https://aishorty.com/docs/api/operations) · [Errors](https://aishorty.com/docs/api/errors) · [Webhooks](https://aishorty.com/docs/api/webhooks) · [Changelog](https://aishorty.com/changelog) · [Developer hub](https://aishorty.com/developers)

get.description: Returns the authenticated account’s plan (Free / Premium / Pro), tier limits (upload sizes, real-time minutes, conversion caps), and current cloud-conversion usage against the daily quota.

Returns the authenticated account’s articles (summaries), newest first, cursor-paginated. Pass the previous response’s `next_cursor` as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page; a cursor is only valid against the SAME query it was minted under.

Full-text search over the authenticated account’s own articles (matches title, description, source URL). `q` is required. Results are recency-ranked; pass `limit` (1–20, default 8) to size the page. This endpoint is page-limited rather than cursor-paginated because search is a ranked top-N, which a keyset cursor cannot express.

Returns one article, including its generated summary parts and extracted body text. You can read your own articles and any public one, which includes the `article_id` that POST /v1/summaries returns as `already_complete` for a video or web page another account summarized first. A non-existent id, or a private article (pasted text, an uploaded file or a private share link) that belongs to another account, returns 404.

Returns the authenticated account’s transcriptions, newest first, cursor-paginated. Pass the previous response’s `next_cursor` as `?cursor=` for the next page; a cursor is only valid against the SAME query it was minted under.

post.description: Starts an async transcription of media at the given URL. Responds 202 with a `Location` header and a `job_id` you can poll at GET /v1/jobs/{id}; the same id is the `transcription_id` you read the result with at GET /v1/transcriptions/{id}. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe. The URL must be a direct link to an audio or video file: a YouTube link is refused with 400 (summarize the video instead; the article carries its transcript), as is any web page. A free account has a monthly allowance: when it is used up the response is 429 with the `quota_exhausted` code (a burst limit is the `rate_limited` code). A transcription that finds no audio ends in ERROR and does not use the allowance. If the transcription service cannot start the job, responds 503.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Optional client-generated key (1–255 visible ASCII chars) that makes this POST replay-safe: a retry with the SAME key and body returns the original response (with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`) instead of creating a duplicate. Reusing a key with a different body is rejected (422).

parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (1–255 visible ASCII chars) that makes this POST replay-safe: a retry with the SAME key and body returns the original response (with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`) instead of creating a duplicate. Reusing a key with a different body is rejected (422).

get.description: Returns one transcription the authenticated account owns, including the transcript text. A non-existent or foreign id returns 404. When `output_language` was set, each GET advances the translation by one slice of work and can take up to about a minute to answer (use a client timeout of at least 60 seconds): keep polling until `translation_status` is SUCCEEDED, FAILED or SKIPPED (see `translation_progress`).

Returns the status of an async job the authenticated account started (a summary, transcription, or subtitle job created via a POST here). The body is the canonical nested job-status shape used across every Shorty surface. A non-existent or foreign job id returns 404. A transcription created with `output_language` reports SUCCESS when the transcript is ready, before its translation is done: keep polling GET /v1/transcriptions/{transcriptionId} until `translation_status` is SUCCEEDED, FAILED or SKIPPED.

Returns a short-lived presigned URL for a completed subtitle job’s artifact. Use `?kind=` to pick srt (default), vtt, ass, or the burned-in mp4. A job that is not complete returns 409; a missing or foreign job id returns 404; an artifact kind not generated for the job returns 404.

post.description: Starts an async summary job for a YouTube video, a web page, or pasted text, selected by the `source` field. Usually responds 202 with a `Location` header and a `job_id` you can poll at GET /v1/jobs/{id} (send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe). If the exact source was already summarized in the requested language (by anyone, not only by you) it responds 200 `already_complete` with the `article_id` and no job to poll; read it at GET /v1/articles/{id}. A web-page `url` whose path ends in `.doc` (a legacy Word file, which the web-page summarizer cannot read) is refused with 422 `unsupported_document_format` before any job starts.

post.description: Starts an async subtitle job for media at the given URL. Responds 202 with a `Location` header and a `job_id` you can poll at GET /v1/jobs/{id}. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe. Exceeding the monthly free quota returns 429 (quota_exhausted); a Premium-only subtitle style or a free-plan duration/size cap returns 403 (feature_not_enabled); media over the hard duration/size ceiling returns 413 (request_too_large); an upstream start failure returns 503.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account’s webhook endpoints, newest first. Signing secrets are never listed: an endpoint’s secret is returned once, when it is created.

post.description: Registers an HTTPS endpoint for job events and returns it with its `whsec_` signing secret, which is shown only in this response. Shorty immediately POSTs a signed `ping` event to the URL; a 2xx answer sets `verified_at`, and only verified endpoints receive events. A URL that is not public HTTPS on port 443 is refused with 400 `validation_failed`; an account already at its endpoint limit gets 429 `quota_exhausted`.

delete.description: Deletes one of the authenticated account’s webhook endpoints and any deliveries still queued for it. A non-existent or foreign id returns 404.

url.description: A URL to audio/video media to transcribe.

language.description: Language name ("english") or ISO-639-1 code ("en"). Defaults to english.

output_language.description: Language to deliver the transcript in, as an ISO 639-1 code. "en" is produced by the speech model itself and is free; every other language is a translation of the finished transcript and requires Shorty Premium.

language.description: Language name ("english") or ISO-639-1 code ("en"). Defaults to english.

url.description: A web page / article URL to summarize.

language.description: Language name ("english") or ISO-639-1 code ("en"). Defaults to english.

title.description: Optional title hint (reserved — currently derived by the summarizer).

language.description: Language name ("english") or ISO-639-1 code ("en"). Defaults to english.

url.description: A URL to the media to caption.

language.description: Language name ("english") or ISO-639-1 code ("en"). Defaults to english.

style.description: Subtitle style. CLEAN, MINIMAL and CLASSIC are on every plan; the others require Premium.

duration_seconds.description: Measured media duration in seconds, if known. Lets the API reject media over your plan’s duration cap up front (413) instead of failing the job later.

url.description: A public HTTPS URL on port 443. Private, loopback and metadata addresses are refused.

event_types.description: The events to deliver (at least one).

isSubscribed.description: Whether the account has any active paid access.

isProSubscriber.description: Whether the account holds the Pro entitlement.

isOnTrial.description: Whether the account is currently in a free trial.

trialEndsAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the trial ends, or null.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp access expires, or null if perpetual/none.

willRenew.description: Whether the subscription auto-renews, or null if not applicable.

maxUploadSizeGb.description: Maximum upload size for a transcription, in GB.

maxUploadSizeLabel.description: Display label for the upload size limit.

realtimeMaxDurationMinutes.description: Maximum real-time transcription duration, in minutes.

realtimeMaxDurationLabel.description: Display label for the real-time duration limit.

maxFileSizeMb.description: Maximum file size for a conversion, in MB.

maxFileSizeLabel.description: Display label for the conversion file-size limit.

maxBatchItems.description: Maximum number of files in a single batch conversion.

canUseManagedQueue.description: Whether the account may use the managed cloud conversion queue.

dailyCloudQuota.description: Daily cloud-conversion quota, or null for unlimited (paid tiers).

cloudConversionsUsedLast24h.description: Cloud conversions consumed in the last 24 hours.

cloudConversionsRemaining.description: Cloud conversions remaining today, or null for unlimited.

type.description: A URI identifying the problem type.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: HTTP status code, duplicated for convenience.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: Identifies this specific occurrence (a request URN).

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code clients switch on.

request_id.description: The request id (also sent as the Request-Id header).

pointer.description: JSON-pointer-ish path to the offending input field, e.g. "#/body/url".

message.description: Human-readable explanation of this field error.

has_more.description: Whether another page exists after this one.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (pass as `?cursor=`), or null on the last page. Only valid against the SAME query filter.

id.description: Stable article id (use it on GET /v1/articles/{id}).

title.description: Article title, or null if not yet summarized.

article_type.description: Source kind: YOUTUBE_ARTICLE, WEBPAGE_ARTICLE, PDF_ARTICLE, WORD_ARTICLE, TEXT_ARTICLE, or AUDIO_ARTICLE.

source_url.description: The original source URL, or null (e.g. text/file input).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the article was created.

count.description: Number of hits returned on this page.

id.description: Stable article id (use it on GET /v1/articles/{id}).

title.description: Article title, or null if not yet summarized.

article_type.description: Source kind: YOUTUBE_ARTICLE, WEBPAGE_ARTICLE, PDF_ARTICLE, WORD_ARTICLE, TEXT_ARTICLE, or AUDIO_ARTICLE.

source_url.description: The original source URL, or null (e.g. text/file input).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the article was created.

parts.description: The ordered sections of the generated summary.

summary.description: The generated summary, or null if not yet produced.

body_text.description: The extracted source text / transcript backing the summary, or null.

has_more.description: Whether another page exists after this one.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (pass as `?cursor=`), or null on the last page. Only valid against the SAME query filter.

status.description: Processing status: PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, or ERROR. The matching job at GET /v1/jobs/{id} spells it differently (lower-case `success`); `normalized_status` is the same in both.

normalized_status.description: `status` in the vocabulary GET /v1/jobs/{id} also reports as `normalized_status`: PENDING is QUEUED, COMPLETED is SUCCESS. SUCCESS and ERROR are final.

language.description: Requested/detected language, or null for auto-detect.

input_file.description: The source media URL that was transcribed.

error.description: Error message if the job failed, else null.

anyOf.description: Language to deliver the transcript in, as an ISO 639-1 code. "en" is produced by the speech model itself and is free; every other language is a translation of the finished transcript and requires Shorty Premium.

output_language.description: The language the transcript was requested in, or null when none was requested.

translation_status.description: State of the translation into `output_language`: PENDING and RUNNING are in flight, SUCCEEDED means `translated_output_text` is ready, SKIPPED means the audio already was in that language, FAILED means it could not be translated (see `translation_error`). Null when no translation was needed (no output language, or English, which the speech model produces directly).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the transcription was created.

job_id.description: The id of the accepted async job.

jobId.description: The job id again, under the camelCase name GET /v1/jobs/{id} uses. Identical to `job_id`.

tracking_url.description: Relative path to poll this job’s status (GET /v1/jobs/{id}).

transcription_id.description: The transcription id: read the result at GET /v1/transcriptions/{id}. Identical to `job_id`.

status.description: Processing status: PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, or ERROR. The matching job at GET /v1/jobs/{id} spells it differently (lower-case `success`); `normalized_status` is the same in both.

normalized_status.description: `status` in the vocabulary GET /v1/jobs/{id} also reports as `normalized_status`: PENDING is QUEUED, COMPLETED is SUCCESS. SUCCESS and ERROR are final.

language.description: Requested/detected language, or null for auto-detect.

input_file.description: The source media URL that was transcribed.

error.description: Error message if the job failed, else null.

anyOf.description: Language to deliver the transcript in, as an ISO 639-1 code. "en" is produced by the speech model itself and is free; every other language is a translation of the finished transcript and requires Shorty Premium.

output_language.description: The language the transcript was requested in, or null when none was requested.

translation_status.description: State of the translation into `output_language`: PENDING and RUNNING are in flight, SUCCEEDED means `translated_output_text` is ready, SKIPPED means the audio already was in that language, FAILED means it could not be translated (see `translation_error`). Null when no translation was needed (no output language, or English, which the speech model produces directly).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the transcription was created.

output_text.description: The speech engine result as a JSON-encoded STRING (text, segments, language, duration), or null if not yet produced. Kept for existing callers; read `text` and `segments` instead of parsing it.

text.description: The transcript as plain text, or null if not yet produced. Empty for a recording with no speech in it.
text.example: Okay, we are trying this for a second time.

text.description: What was said in the segment.

segments.description: The transcript cut into timed segments, or null when none is available.

translated_output_text.description: The transcript translated into `output_language`, in the same format as `output_text`, or null until `translation_status` is SUCCEEDED.

done_batches.description: Batches of the transcript translated so far.

total_batches.description: Batches the transcript is cut into.

translation_progress.description: How far a translation in flight has got, so a client can show "Translating... 40%". Each GET of this endpoint advances it by a few batches (about 20 seconds of work); keep polling until `translation_status` is terminal. Null until the first batch starts and when no translation is owed.

translation_error.description: Why the translation failed when `translation_status` is FAILED, else null. The untranslated `output_text` is unaffected.

job_id.description: The job id again, under the snake_case name the 202 response uses. Identical to `jobId`.

status.description: Un-normalized status string (queued / processing / success / error / cancelled). Read `normalized_status` to compare it with a transcription’s `normalized_status`.

normalized_status.description: `status` in the one vocabulary shared with the transcription resources: QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCESS, ERROR or CANCELLED. SUCCESS, ERROR and CANCELLED are final.

error.description: Error message if the job failed, or null.

output.description: Job-type-specific extras: `jobType`, `title`, `outputId`, and the id of the result. `articleId` is set on a summary job once the article exists (read it at GET /v1/articles/{articleId}); `transcriptionId` is set on a transcription job (read it at GET /v1/transcriptions/{transcriptionId}).

url.description: Short-lived presigned URL to download the subtitle artifact.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the presigned URL expires.

kind.description: Artifact kind: srt/vtt/ass subtitle file, or the burned-in mp4.

status.description: Marks a cache hit: this exact source was already summarized, so no new job was started.

article_id.description: The id of the already-complete article — fetch it at GET /v1/articles/{id}. It is readable by this account even when another account summarized the source first.

job_id.description: The id of the accepted async job, or null when the job was accepted but is not trackable (poll is unavailable).

jobId.description: The job id again, under the camelCase name GET /v1/jobs/{id} uses. Identical to `job_id`, null when it is.

tracking_url.description: Relative path to poll this job (GET /v1/jobs/{id}), or null when tracking is unavailable.

article_id.description: The created article id — present only on the accepted-but-untrackable case, so the caller can still locate the result at GET /v1/articles/{id}.

job_id.description: The id of the accepted async job.

jobId.description: The job id again, under the camelCase name GET /v1/jobs/{id} uses. Identical to `job_id`.

tracking_url.description: Relative path to poll this job’s status (GET /v1/jobs/{id}).

url.description: The HTTPS URL Shorty POSTs events to.

description.description: Your label for the endpoint, or null.

enabled.description: False when the endpoint was disabled by hand or by the failure ladder.

verified_at.description: When the endpoint answered the verification ping with a 2xx, or null. Events are only delivered to verified endpoints.

disabled_at.description: When the endpoint was disabled, or null.

disabled_reason.description: Why it was disabled ("manual" or "auto_failure_ladder"), or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the endpoint was created.

secret.description: The endpoint’s `whsec_` signing secret. Returned only here: store it to verify the `webhook-signature` header of every delivery.

BearerApiKey.description: A Shorty API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. An OAuth 2.1 access token issued to a connected app is also accepted on the same header.
